question.text: Investment Approach (IA) strategy tagging and benchmark selection for performance reporting by portfolio managers are required under:

answer.text: SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020 and related SEBI circulars

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook explains that, under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020 and the linked SEBI circulars on performance benchmarking, each Investment Approach must be formally defined, tagged to a strategy, and aligned to a designated benchmark for performance disclosure. The Trap: PMLA, PIT Regulations and the Companies Act address other obligations (anti-money laundering, insider trading prohibitions and corporate governance respectively); the IA strategy tagging and benchmark selection requirement comes from the PM Regulations and SEBI circulars. Note: Maintain an internal IA register that records the strategy tag and chosen benchmark for each approach so that disclosures and marketing material can be cross-checked during SEBI inspections.
